item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 09/Oct/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, the weather is expected to be generally fine and dry over the coast of southern China this week. It will be cooler in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. On the other hand, the broad area of low pressure over the seas east of the Philippines will develop gradually in the next couple of days, and move towards the Philippines.

Date/Month: 10/10 (Monday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Mainly fine. Very dry during the day.
Temp range: 22 - 28 C
R.H. range: 35 - 65 per Cent
PSR: Low
